name: StepRndFlt
description: Tempo-synced sample-and-hold LFO into a multimode resonant TPT SVF on AUDIO IN. Each step redraws a random cutoff offset around CUT. TYPE selects Peak / LP12 / LP24 / BPF / HP12 / HP24 / Var. Var morphs continuously across LPF24→LPF12→BPF→HPF12→HPF24 and redraws that SVF-type position each step (slewed with SLEW). X = LFO depth, Y = resonance (capped). LEVEL scales wet into a final softclip. Hold the pad to engage; release returns to dry.

params.name: DEPTH
params.detail: How far each S&H step moves cutoff around CUT (± octaves)

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Dry/wet while the pad is held

params.name: CUT
params.detail: Center cutoff the S&H LFO modulates around

params.name: TYPE
params.detail: Filter mode: Peak, LP12, LP24, BPF, HP12, HP24, Var (continuous LPF24→…→HPF24 morph, S&H per step)

params.name: SLEW
params.detail: How quickly cutoff slews, and how long Var SVF-type linearly ramps between steps

params.name: LEVEL
params.detail: Wet level into the final softclip
